question_text: A 31 year-old-man presents to an urgent care clinic with symptoms of lower abdominal pain, bloating, bloody diarrhea, and fullness, all of which have become more frequent over the last 3 months. His vital signs are as follows: blood pressure is 121/81 mm Hg, heart rate is 87/min, and respiratory rate is 15/min. Rectal examination reveals a small amount of bright red blood. Lower endoscopy is performed, showing extensive mucosal erythema, induration, and pseudopolyps extending from the rectum to the splenic flexure. Given the following options, what is the definitive treatment for this patient’s underlying disease?
